services.name: TrueNAS
services.securityException: TrueNAS HTTPS/API is intentionally published on public port 7000 by pfSense HAProxy, which terminates public TLS and re-encrypts to 172.17.0.24:7000. This is not a Cloudflare Tunnel; keep the direct exposure visible as security debt and restrict the WAN rule to this listener only.

services.name: pfSense
services.securityException: The pfSense administration UI is LAN/VPN-only. TCP 10443 may be reachable from trusted internal networks but any reachability from FastAPI Cloud or the public Internet is configuration drift and must fail the sickz exposure policy.

services.name: Home
services.securityException: home.albandrieu.com:10443 aliases the pfSense administration UI and is LAN/VPN-only. External reachability must be treated as a security failure.

services.name: Garage
services.securityException: garage.int.albandrieu.com is intentionally published directly through Traefik with Let's Encrypt rather than Cloudflare. Keep this visible as an orange security-debt warning until migrated behind Cloudflare.

services.name: Bichon
services.securityException: Bichon must stay private. Any public DNS or Cloudflare Tunnel entry is configuration drift and must be reported by sickz.

services.name: n8n
services.securityException: n8n currently needs a public webhook path for integrations such as Slack. A broad Cloudflare Access bypass/Everyone policy is intentionally treated as a red security exception; narrow it to the webhook path or replace it with Service Auth.
